paragraphs: Hyman cites Pesikta deRav Kahana, at the end of piska 17, 134a, where Rabbi Simai speaks in the name of Rabbi Yochai. Hyman records the reading in Shir HaShirim Rabbah at פ״ח-פ:ו-ג as Rabbi Simon ben Kozot in the name of Rabbi Levi.

notes.text: The supplied Shir HaShirim Rabbah locator is פ״ח-פ:ו-ג, including an additional ג. The parallel notice Simon ben Kozot gives 8:6, supporting that portion of the reading; the extra ג is retained and its precise function remains unsettled. Pesikta’s historical 134a is retained without claiming verified printed pagination.

Further comparison: Midrash Rabbah -- TE Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:6:3 names Rabbi Simon ben Kuzit in the name of Rabbi Levi. This supports reading the final ג of supplied פ״ח-פ:ו-ג as the third subsection, without proving Hyman’s exact printed punctuation. The Kozot spelling is preserved as supplied alongside this Kuzit witness; Simai and Simon are not automatically merged.

Buber’s 1868 Pesikta, folio 134a, closes piska 17 with Rabbi Simai bar Kosi quoting Rabbi Yochai on God’s answer to Israel’s requests. Note 81 reports Rabbi Simon bar Kei quoting Rabbi Yochanan in the Oxford manuscript and Rabbi Simon quoting Rabbi Yochanan in Yalkut. In the parallel in Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:6:3, Rabbi Simon ben Kuzit quotes Rabbi Levi. Hyman’s separate Simon ben Kozot entry also points to the Pesikta parallel.
